meta.name: Khauf 2025
meta.description:
Madhu moves into a hostel in Delhi to start afresh, but her room hides a sinister presence that begins to get stronger each day, alarming the other women on her floor. They know what the room hides and desperately want her gone before it is too late for them all.

Complete series. On your server: S1 8/8

videos.title: Ladies Hostel
videos.overview: Madhu arrives in Delhi and moves into a hostel but is warned that there is something wrong with her room – she should leave before it is too late.

videos.title: Stalker
videos.overview: The Warden brings a shaman known as ‘Doctor,’ to check the room, while Madhu is led by her instinct to hunt for her assaulter.

videos.title: Venom
videos.overview: Madhu decides to confront Nakul and face her fears, while the women in the hostel make a pact with the Doctor.

videos.title: Fever
videos.overview: As the Doctor becomes increasingly desperate for her, a transformed Madhu feels her rage spill out in dangerous ways.

videos.title: Possessed
videos.overview: Dr Shohini begins an inquiry into the events at the hostel, while Madhu unleashes a night of blood and vengeance.

videos.title: Trap
videos.overview: Nikki tries to leave the hostel in a desperate attempt, while Madhu is entrapped by the Doctor.

videos.title: Happy New Year
videos.overview: Confronted by the Warden, the women come clean about what happened in the hostel during last year’s New Year’s Eve celebration.

videos.title: The Reverie
videos.overview: While the Doctor hunts for her, a possessed Madhu reaches the hostel for a faceoff with the women, battling both the entity inside her and the trauma of her past.
